facts: Structured-light methods actively generate geometric correspondence data.
The geometric correspondence data are between projectors and cameras.
The paper presents Photogeometric Structured Light.
Photogeometric Structured Light extends a standard structured light method to include photometric methods.
Photogeometric Structured Light includes photometric methods.
Photometric processing increases the amount of recovered surface detail.
Photometric processing enables the structured-light setup to be robustly self-calibrated.
Photometric processing serves a double purpose.
The Photogeometric Structured Light framework uses a photogeometric optimization.
The photogeometric optimization supports the simultaneous use of multiple cameras and projectors.
The photogeometric optimization yields a single and accurate multi-view 3D model.
The multi-view 3D model best complies with photometric and geometric data.
